name: cleanroom_r2e_reaction_center_residual_v2
purpose: Retain the useful mapped reaction-center signal from center-v1 without reinitializing or moving the proven RDKit+ source towers: inject the unchanged 1280-d center block through an exactly zero-initialized hidden residual and train only that residual on fold-train associations.

predecessor.constraint: No center radius, dimensions, tokenization or base RDKit+ features are changed from v1. Only integration/training topology changes.

base: the already frozen 3139-d RDKit+ cleanroom checkpoint for each matching historical fold
reaction_features: the exact 4419-d drfp_categorical_rdkitplus_center_v1 matrix from center-v1; first 3139 columns are base and last 1280 columns are auxiliary center features

model.mechanism: original LayerNorm+Linear operate only on the original 3139-d block; a bias-free 1280->768 auxiliary projection is added to the first hidden pre-activation
model.initialization: auxiliary projection exactly zero; pre-continuation reaction embeddings must match the source RDKit+ checkpoint with max_abs_diff <= 1e-7

training.provenance: Reuse the pre-existing identity-preserving RDKit+ isolate continuation recipe from RDKITPLUS_OUTER_EXECUTION_V1 rather than selecting hyperparameters from center-v1 performance.

screening_rule.fold_stability: Hard-slice MRR and MAP must both improve in at least 2 of 3 development folds; neither may regress by more than 0.005 absolute in any fold.
screening_rule.broad_all_query_guard: Across pooled folds0/1/2 R2E, MRR/MAP may not regress by >0.002 absolute and Hit@10/20/50 may not regress by >0.005 absolute.
screening_rule.if_pass: Freeze a brand-new salted strict double-cold confirmation protocol before any confirmation performance is materialized; no previously revealed fold/outer cell may substitute.
screening_rule.if_fail: Reject residual-v2 without tuning its continuation recipe from these results.
